items.title: Downloadable update Saturday
items.summary: Minor fixes and features. About 4 hours down, about 100GB to download.

blocks.heading: Changes to gear
bullets: Example: a popular weapon-damage talent is eased back slightly.
Example: a sustain brand gets a small armor-regen bump.
Example: one skill-haste brand loses a little cooldown reduction.

blocks.heading: Fixes
bullets: Example: stash menu crash when sorting a full inventory.
Example: matchmaking desync after a countdown run.
Example: specialization ammo not refilling on a safe-house visit.

items.title: Scheduled maintenance
items.summary: Routine maintenance. Expect about 5 hours of downtime.

blocks.text: Routine maintenance while the servers restart. Log out before the window so progress can save. The game will be unavailable for about five hours.

items.title: Season event almost finished
items.summary: Farm the remaining rewards while the window is still open.

image.alt: Agent on a rooftop over the city at dusk

blocks.heading: The window
blocks.text: Red Horizon’s limited event is nearly over. Rewards on the free track and the seasonal activity stay up until the window closes.

blocks.heading: Before it ends
bullets: Run the seasonal activity while matchmaking is still busy.
Open the season page for manhunts, maps, and modifiers.
